stage: Bounded deployed reproduction, not performance estimation
cluster: segmentation-attribution, one local Kind node, Kubernetes v1.36.1
primary_endpoint: Number of per-policy metrics for two policy objects, plus negative reported latency
design: Two namespaces, one measured ingress policy per namespace, distinct directed flows. Run same-name baseline, unique-name control, then namespace-key correction if baseline runs successfully.
threshold: Retain example P99 10 seconds. No induced slow-policy failure and no claim of live false-pass reproduction from metric collapse alone.
timing: QPS 1, burst 1, 15-second job pause; no tuning against outcomes
image_handling: First run resolves upstream latest tags; capture actual running image IDs and pin follow-up runs to these digests.
stop: 3-minute per-run timeout. Preserve failures. Do not launch broad sweeps or HPC jobs.
novelty: Conventional identity bug. A deployed reproduction strengthens evidence but does not establish a new research contribution.
provenance: pod.yml, np-deny-all.yml and np-allow-from-proxy.yml copied from pinned upstream examples under Apache-2.0. Config adapted from that example. ingress-np.yml is a controlled research template.
